jobs.description: Ready to build your future in logistics? Join Arvato in Heijen! Are you enthusiastic, hands-on and ready for a new challenge? Then Arvato in Heijen could be the perfect place for you! Wie zoeken we? Previous experience in a warehouse or logistics environment is an advantage, but certainly not a requirement. What matters most is your motivation and attention to detail. You should also meet the following requirements: English language skills at A2 level or higher Available to work full-time in a two-shift system Flexible and willing to work different hours when required Able to work accurately and maintain a structured approach A proactive attitude and a strong sense of responsibility Wat bieden wij je?
